title: Sewing Specialist – Freelance AI Trainer Project
description:
Are you an experienced sewing professional with hands-on knowledge of sewing machines, production lines, and garment assembly eager to help shape how AI understands manufacturing work? As AI systems increasingly model factory operations and production workflows, their accuracy depends on training data grounded in real sewing environments. That training data begins with people who know the work firsthand.

We’re seeking Sewing Specialists with tangible, hands-on experience operating sewing machines and working within garment production lines. This includes experience with sewing line operations, task flow between stations, and multi-purpose manufacturing operators that support material movement and production efficiency. You’ll challenge AI models on realistic sewing and assembly scenarios involving machine operation, workflow coordination, production pacing, and common operational issues on the factory floor.

On a typical day, you will engage the model on sewing and production-line scenarios, validate whether its understanding of sewing operations reflects real-world practice, evaluate descriptions of machine use and line coordination, analyze workflow inefficiencies or errors, document gaps in model understanding, and provide feedback to improve how the model reasons about garment production work.

General sewing and garment manufacturing experience is ideal, including familiarity with industrial sewing machines, assembly-line processes, and day-to-day production operations...
